messages:
maya: FYI trying to bring up llama-2-7b-redwood-conv from HF mirror. Conversion produced both tokenizer.json and tokenizer_config.json but they disagree on special tokens.
chen: What's the runtime symptom?
maya: In the fast tokenizer (tokenizer.json) <bos>/<eos>/<pad> exist, but tokenizer_config.json points at slow-tokenizer files that weren't exported. At load time the loader tries slow path, hits missing files, and ends up with special_tokens=None — chat template generation then spits out empty role tokens.
sam: Oof. Did our HF->Redwood conversion script accidentally write a tokenizer_config that references slow-only artifacts? We saw similar with conversion wrapper v0.9.
maya: Yep. Conversion log shows a warning: "slow tokenizer files missing, wrote tokenizer_config.json with slow-only refs". I think the converter prefers the slow metadata when both are present.
chen: Any quick patch to get evals/quantization running?
maya: Two options: (1) force Redwood to use the fast tokenizer by adding "preferred_tokenizer": "fast" into config.json/model card, or (2) regenerate slow tokenizer artifacts (vocab.json + merges.txt) from the fast tokenizer so slow codepath can load.
sam: For the short term, which is less risky for the quant experiments?
maya: For the quant runs I'd prefer forcing fast; it's just a config tweak and doesn't touch tokenizer bytes. The quant pipeline failed earlier because pad_token_id was None and the quant runner expects pad_token_id present.
chen: Can you share the patch you used?
maya: I applied this local patch on disk:
```
# make tokenizer_config explicitly prefer fast
jq '.preferred_tokenizer="fast" | .model_max_length=4096' tokenizer_config.json > tmp && mv tmp tokenizer_config.json
# keep a backup
cp tokenizer.json tokenizer.json.bak
```
Then restarted the onboarding loader. That allowed the fast tokeniser to be used and quant job proceeded further.
sam: Nice. We should update converter to set preferred_tokenizer when it detects tokenizer.json has special tokens but slow artifacts are missing.
maya: Agreed. I'll open a PR. Also adding a small CI check: onboarding should assert `special_tokens_map` exists and both fast/slow references are consistent (or preferred_tokenizer declared).
infra-bot: HEADS-UP: deploy-checklist updated, added step `tokenizer_consistency` for model imports.
chen: Can you paste the exact failing log segment we saw earlier?
maya: Pasted below:
```
INFO: converting tokenizer
WARNING: tokenizer_config.json references slow tokenizer files that are not present: vocab.json missing
ERROR: TokenizerFactory could not instantiate slow tokenizer -> falling back to naive encoder. Special tokens: None
```
sam: OK filed a small tracking ticket so this doesn't get lost in PR noise.
maya: Created ML-5321 and assigned to myself. PR coming soon with: (a) converter change to prefer fast when slow files missing, (b) onboarding CI check, (c) short doc note about `preferred_tokenizer`.
chen: :thumbsup: ping when PR is up and I'll trigger the quant/regression job.
maya: will do. Thanks!
